knownHazards: Billing is permanently forbidden: never attach Cloud Billing, enable Blaze, add a payment method, activate Cloud Run, or select a paid provider path.
Firebase must remain Spark and Firestore persistence must remain memory-only.
Remote Joining code must remain browser-inert until an explicit host/join/read/close action; ordinary startup must not create session writes.
Standard Firebase request.auth.uid authenticates the account. Registered deviceId remains account-owned mutation metadata, not a cryptographic browser identity.
Session collection listing, discovery, lobbies, matchmaking, community and rankings remain prohibited; exact private session IDs only.
Canonical localStorage remains exactly careerModeShowdown.saveLibrary, careerModeShowdown.legacyShowdowns and careerModeShowdown.preferences; session operations must not mutate canonical local saves.
Candidate C remains the only destructive remote-to-local Apply authority for gameplay data.
The protected historical rivalry must not be edited, forced, deleted or used for destructive testing.
Spark quota or provider failure must fail closed while local Career Mode remains playable.
